about: Sahoshi's Kolkata road network: the RESOLVED mapping table — GENERATED by scripts/gen_osm_network.py --city kolkata from cities/kolkata/corridors.json (every junction on the OSM node where its roads meet, every via point on its road, cameras and stations placed); do not edit by hand.  Kolkata's curated corridor network (City Pack cities/kolkata/): the junctions (landmarks.json ids and spellings where the junction is a landmark; EN + Bengali names), the segments along the real OpenStreetMap roads between them, the station selection and the camera rules. scripts/gen_osm_network.py --city kolkata resolves every junction to the OSM node where its roads meet (nearest its anchor), traces every segment along its roads (one-ways honoured), and writes the seed SQL, scripts/data/osm_network.json (evidence), scripts/data/osm_network_map.json (the resolved table) and cities/kolkata/network.json. Road data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
